assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied photograph of the actual bronze Franz Kafka bust in Kielce. Make a faithful transparent-background cutout of ONLY the bronze sculpture from the top of its bowler hat through its existing short flat-bottomed neck/bow tie base. Remove the trees, grass, granite pedestal and all lettering. Preserve the original photographic sculptural identity, asymmetrical angular face, entire round bowler hat, bronze brown/grey patina, rough hand-modelled texture, proportions, frontal viewpoint and original lighting. Do not invent a different portrait, reinterpret the sculpture, smooth the bronze, add shoulders or a new pedestal, change materials to ivory, or add graphic flourishes. Output a genuine RGBA PNG with transparent pixels outside the sculpture, no background or fake checkerboard, no cast shadow. Portrait canvas 1024x1536; fit the complete sculpture proportionately, centered horizontally, roughly 3% transparent space above and 2% below. No clipping of hat edges. This is a source-photo extraction for a bookshelf ornament, NOT a newly designed bust.
